DA.name: Delegate Affairs
DA.text: We know that choosing the right committee can be overwhelming, so we created this quiz to make it easier and even a little fun! We can't wait to see you thrive in committee at KINGMUN 2025 experience!

SG.name: Secretary-General
SG.text: Whether you're here to challenge yourself or explore something new, I hope this helps you find where you'll shine at KINGMUN 2025.

IS.name: Internal Secretariat
IS.text: Our team put a lot of thought into designing committees that are engaging, creative, and, most importantly, perfect for you. This tool is our way of guiding you through our various committees!
